Trusts
Beneficiary of The Maurice Scarpaleggia estate trust
? 
The trust was not established for political reasons and I am ordered by the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, as required by subsection 41.3(2) of the Parliament of Canada Act, not to derive any income from it, including the distribution of assets on its termination, for the purpose of financing a nomination contest, a leadership contest or an electoral campaign.
